name: Pasquale Tridico - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2024, Section II – European Council and Council
part_text:
The European Parliament is refusing, for now, to sign off on how the Council spent its 2024 budget (about 677 million euros). It says the Council has refused for years to answer Parliament's questions or attend hearings, so Parliament cannot check the spending properly. The report asks the Council to cooperate, publish more about its spending and contracts, and open its law-making documents. It also calls for changes to the European Union treaties so Parliament can formally approve each institution's spending.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament postpones its approval and asks the Council to cooperate and publish more.
- **Who it affects:** The Council, the European Council and their staff, plus European Union taxpayers.
- **What happens next:** Parliament wants top-level talks between the two institutions to end the deadlock.
